name: SSO-OIDC-RBAC-Testing
description: Advanced OIDC authentication with role-based library access control
overview: OpenID Connect SSO with role-to-library mapping, multi-provider support, and admin UI.

versions.changelog: Security: validate JWT signatures against IdP JWKS endpoint; enforce nonce on all tokens; enable discovery endpoint URL validation; add per-provider strict access token validation toggle; prevent XSS in login button script generation; demote IdP error descriptions from error to debug logs
Remove unsafe display name sync: fallback lookup by display name risks matching wrong users; disable in UI pending Jellyfin upstream ExternalSubjectId support
Fix display name sync crashing on Jellyfin 10.11.10: IUserManager.RenameUser removed in that version; now sets Username directly via UpdateUserAsync
Respect disabled flag on existing users (blocked from SSO login); opt-in display name sync from OIDC token; preserve disabled flag in RBAC policy updates
Fix admin not showing in UI: switch to UpdatePolicyAsync to properly refresh Jellyfin runtime state; apply RBAC before session creation so token captures correct admin flag
Fix admin/RBAC permissions not persisting: apply role mappings after AuthenticateDirect so Jellyfin cannot overwrite them; add post-update verification with retry
Fix OidcAuthProvider not registered with Jellyfin DI; fix new user creation crashing on ChangePassword; fix MaxParentalRating defaulting to 0; fix credential storage missing ServerId
